name: Niijima (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Niijima village emblem in white: a stylised device of four loops, like a butterfly.
history: Municipal flag of Niijima, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 January 1978.

features.role: Niijima village emblem — a stylised device of four loops, like a butterfly
